title: subscription.changed
description: User subscription plan or status changed.

current_period_end.description: End of the current billing period (renewal/expiry moment), populated from the provider subscription object. null means not yet known (e.g. the checkout.session.completed milestone, before the customer.subscription.created event lands) — never a fabricated zero timestamp.

comped_until.description: When an operator-granted comp window closes, on the event that granted it (stapel_billing.services.extend_subscription). Absent on every provider-driven change. While the window is open `plan` is the comped plan, which can rank ABOVE the plan the provider is charging for; `current_period_end` stays the provider's own, so a consumer can tell 'paid until' from 'comped until' instead of inferring one from the other.

cancel_at_period_end.description: True when the subscriber has cancelled and the subscription runs to the end of the paid period without renewing. Not inferable from `status`, which stays 'active' for the whole remaining period — a consumer reading only `status` cannot tell a live subscription from one that is ending, which is how paying customers reached a cancellation date nobody had told them about. Always emitted.
